title: Rover Work First Hands At Stoppage (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica steel guitar fiddle
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Son. Rover. You are EVERYWHERE.
You are first to the ball, last to the water break

[Verse 1]
Ruck taps the ball to the space
You are already there, know the place
Pre-read the tap direction, two steps in
First hands to the ball means your team wins

Fifty fifty contest at the stoppage ground
Sprint to the ruck, be the first one found
Low hands, fast hands, move the ball on
Quick handball to space, delay is gone

[Pre-Chorus]
Read the tap, pre-position now
First to the ground is the rover vow
Low hands fast hands, move the rock
Rover work never stops the clock

[Chorus]
Rover at the stoppage, first to the ground
Quick hands and fast feet, move it around
Read the tap direction, be there first
Rover work, first hands, quench the thirst

[Verse 2]
Fitness is the rovers greatest asset
Thirty stoppages a game, that is the target
Sprint recovery sprint recovery, all day long
Rover fitness is the rovers greatest song

[Bridge]
Bluey: AND HE IS THERE FIRST AT THE STOPPAGE, INCREDIBLE WORK RATE
Trevor: His stoppage clearance rate this season is forty-three percent, elite level
Chas: Thirty laps every Tuesday morning. That is the whole secret right there.

[Chorus]
Rover at the stoppage, first to the ground
Quick hands and fast feet, move it around
Read the tap direction, be there first
Rover work, first hands, quench the thirst

[Outro]
First to the ball son
First. To. The. Ball.
Thats my boy
